notes: v199: Report an Issue — in the Menu and in Settings. Pick a kind (bug, crash, balance, idea), describe it, optionally leave an email for a reply, and send. The game log (recent events, world news, errors and device info, no personal data) is attached; you can preview it or save it as a text file. Reports go straight to the developer; if that can't get through (offline), your email app opens with the report and the log is saved to attach.
